title: A Great Gift...For Yourself!
text: I just received my first box from La Tea Dah Premium Tea subscription and was absolutely delighted with it. The tea is fantastic. I tried the Raspberry Oolong first. It is a sweet, lightly flavored tea in a triangle-type bag. I chose this one first because I wanted the caffeine, and although it is not the only flavor containing caffeine, it is the one that appealed to me first.  Later that night I tried the loose tea with the little metal tea holder strainer thing. The tea is very fine, and I had a lot of tea powder coming out of the holder and had powder on the counter, and in my cup. Altogether I received 5 tea bags, each enough for 2 or 3 uses, a sachet dish, a bookmark, a notebook, a recipe card for Mock Mint Green Tea Julep, a teabag in a little brown envelope, a tin of loose tea, and the tea ball holder. I am super happy with this monthly box!
label: positive
